outcome: Damage dealt to a player lowers that player's life total by the damage amount.
A life gain or life loss effect raises or lowers the player's life total by the stated amount.
A life payment is payable only when the life total is at least the payment, and paying lowers the life total by that amount.
A payment of 0 life is always payable, even under an effect that says players can't pay life.
Setting a life total to a number leaves the player at that number by gaining or losing the difference.
A player at 0 or less life loses the game in the next state-based check.
With a can't-gain-life effect, an exchange or redistribution that would raise the life total does not happen and a life-gain cost cannot be paid.
With a can't-lose-life effect, an exchange or redistribution that would lower the life total does not happen and a pay-life cost cannot be paid.
A gain-life trigger fires when a source causes a gain of more than 0 life and does not fire on a gain of 0.
A would-gain-life replacement effect applies when more than 0 life would be gained and does nothing on a gain of 0.
